name: LogoCloud
description: Trust strip for member, customer or partner logos with captions, columns and optional links.
designIntent: Proof logos are repeated on every marketing page with inconsistent sizing, spacing and alt text. LogoCloud makes the strip a named list, keeps the logos decorative and supplies the accessible name once.

props.name: items
props.description: Logos to display: accessible name, decorative artwork and optional href.

examples.title: Member logo strip
examples.code: }, { name: 'North', logo: , href: '/members/north' }, ]} />
examples.description: Decorative logo art with the name supplied as accessible text.

antiPatterns.title: Don't duplicate the name in alt text
antiPatterns.explanation: LogoCloud already renders the item name for assistive tech. Mark the image decorative so screen readers announce it once.

accessibility.implementation: Each item is a list item with an sr-only name; logo artwork is aria-hidden
accessibility.userRequirements: Pass a human-readable name for every logo

accessibility.implementation: Linked logos render as a single focusable link named by the item
accessibility.userRequirements: Use links only when the logo destination is useful

compositionRules.relationship: Place LogoCloud inside a Section so the band controls tone and spacing
